title: The Best Horror Movie Endings Of The 20th Century
description:
A horror movie has to end on a good note, or the audience won’t leave the theater all that scared. Sure, one last jump scare has become so much of a cliché that it was parodied in Scream years ago, but there are other ways to leave viewers unsettled that don’t involve jump scares.

Some classic horror films, like The Thing, leave things on an ambiguous note and let us answer some of the questions ourselves, while other films, like Don’t Look Now and The Sixth Sense, shock us in their final moments. Let’s take a look at the best horror movie endings of the 20th century.
